source:
@@U03723@@
It is 荷蒙库鲁斯 led on by 普罗透斯!
These are the symptoms of imperious longing.
I hear his anguish,
the groan of his suffering.
He'll shatter himself against her radiant throne.
Look there! A flame! A flash!
And he’s spilt in the sea!

@@U03725@@
What radiant miracle transfigures our waters!
Wave breaks on wave in sparkles of light!
Everything lightening, flickering, brightening!
Each body aglow as it moves through the night!
All things radiant as fire flows round!
Let 厄洛斯 reign here, who started it all!
Hail to the waves, to the sea unbounded
By the sacred fire surrounded!
Water, hail! Hail, fire, the splendid!
Hail, o Mystery here ended!

@@U03727@@
Hail bright airs that softly flow,
Hail mysterious vaults below!
Honored now forevermore
Be the Elemental Four!
translation:
@@U03723@@
正是普罗透斯率领的荷蒙库鲁斯！
这些都是专横渴望的症状。
我听到他的痛苦，
他痛苦的呻吟。
他会在她光芒四射的王座上粉碎自己。
看那儿！火焰！一道闪光！
而且他还掉进了海里！

@@U03725@@
多么光辉灿烂的奇迹改变了我们的水域！
波涛汹涌，闪烁着光芒！
一切都在闪电、闪烁、明亮！
每个身体在黑夜中移动时都会发光！
一切事物都像火焰一样光芒四射！
让厄洛斯统治这里，他是这一切的始作俑者！
向海浪致敬，向无边无际的大海致敬
被圣火包围！
水，冰雹！冰雹，火焰，辉煌！
万岁，奥秘到此结束了！

@@U03727@@
欢呼轻柔流动的明亮空气，
下面的神秘金库万岁！
现在受人尊敬直到永远
成为元素四人！
